scenarios.title: A creature with flying can be blocked only by creatures with flying or reach, and a flier can block any creature
decisions: A attacks player B with Wind Drake and Hill Giant.
B declares its Wind Drake as the only blocker, blocking A's Wind Drake.

variants.label: flier_blocks_flier
variants.expected: Legal: B's Wind Drake is among the legal blockers of A's Wind Drake.

variants.expected: Illegal: Grizzly Bears is not among the legal blockers of Wind Drake.

variants.label: reach_blocks_flier

variants.expected: Legal: Giant Spider is among the legal blockers of Wind Drake.

variants.expected: Legal: B's Wind Drake is among the legal blockers of Hill Giant.
